name: claude-code-toolkit
description: Personal toolkit for Claude Code. Bundles a core meta-toolkit for authoring skills, sub-agents, slash commands, plugins, hooks, and CLAUDE.md memory files, plus a development plugin shipping an opinionated senior engineering team (software-developer, software-architect, tech-lead, code-reviewer, quality-engineer, security-engineer) — composable LEGO pieces with transversal practices (evidence levels, code-grounded analysis, no-silent-drift, outputs-as-content) — and twelve methodology-anchored skills (adr, test-plan, development-plan, work-splitting, bug-analysis, threat-model, tech-spec, debugging-protocol, code-audit, code-review-checklist, git-commit, mermaid).

plugins.name: claude-code-core
plugins.description: Meta-skills for authoring Claude Code extensions: scaffold, validate, and audit skills, sub-agents, slash commands, plugins, hooks, and CLAUDE.md memory files against the latest official conventions.

plugins.name: claude-code-development
plugins.description: Opinionated senior engineering team for Claude Code: developer, architect, tech-lead, reviewer, QE, security-eng — composable pieces with transversal practices (evidence levels, code-grounded analysis, no-silent-drift, outputs-as-content). Twelve methodology-anchored bundled skills covering ADR (Nygard), test plan (ISO 29119-3), development plan (spec-kit + SAFe), work-splitting (Lawrence / SPIDR / Hamburger / Carpaccio), bug-analysis (5 Whys / Ishikawa / FTA / blameless postmortem), threat-model (STRIDE / PASTA), tech-spec (C4 / arc42), debugging-protocol (Zeller / git-bisect / observability-first), code-audit (SQALE / Fowler), code-review-checklist (Google / Wiegers / OWASP), git-commit (Conventional Commits), mermaid. Least-privilege tooling, no orchestration baked in.
